title: Can I repair my Barbeque grill on my own?
desc: You should consult with a technician for your grill repair. Attempting repair by yourself can cause health issues.

title: How many times should I repair my Barbeque grill?
desc: It is recommended to maintain your Barbeque grill at least once a year.

title: What are common signs that my grill needs repair?
desc: Common signs include uneven heating, low flame, excessive smoke, gas leakage, or rusting of the burner.

title: Grill is not igniting! What can be the issue?
desc: It could have several factors like a faulty ignition switch, clogged burner, or depleted fuel source.
